**q25.** Engine: CEL (Common Expression Language, `github.com/google/cel-go`) — `internal/filter` (`engine.go:26` `NewEngine`, schema in `schema.go`, parser to IR in `parser.go`/`ir.go`, SQL rendering in `render.go`). Mechanism: the handler validates the filter (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:211` → `validateFilter`), passes it into `store.FindMemo.Filters`, and each dialect driver calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go`), which compiles the CEL AST into a dialect-agnostic condition tree and renders it to dialect-specific SQL + placeholder args (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`, `internal/filter/render.go`).

**q26.**
```
memo (the memo row plus its comment memos) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:574,580; store/db/sqlite/memo.go:239
memo_relation (both memo_id and related_memo_id directions) — store/memo.go:142,145
attachment (rows + backing blob/file storage) — store/memo.go:148-157, store/attachment.go:132
memo_share — only via DB-level FK ON DELETE CASCADE (postgres/LATEST.sql:108, mysql/LATEST.sql:108); on SQLite this does not fire, since the connection sets _pragma=foreign_keys(0) (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53)
```
`reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the Vite build output is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo static middleware with an SPA fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed) and `:40-60` (`FrontendService.Serve`), invoked from `server/server.go:70`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign.Runner — started at server/server.go:157-167: one immediate RunOnce, then a time.Ticker every 12 hours (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-40)
```
Unused infra notes: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron-expression job scheduler, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`) is **not** used by the server — it is referenced only from its own tests. `server/runner/memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` is likewise never started; only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from the memo handlers (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`). Other long-lived goroutines that are not "runners": store cache cleanup loops (`store/cache/cache.go:83,200`), 4 webhook async dispatch workers (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:41-54`), and the SSE heartbeat ticker (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:64`).

**q29.**
```
interceptor path — web/src/connect.ts:148 (authInterceptor, installed on the transport at :174-179)
token kinds — short-lived JWT access token (15 min) sent as "Authorization: Bearer", cached in memory + localStorage (web/src/auth-state.ts); long-lived refresh token in the httpOnly cookie "memos_refresh" (credentials: "include"), refreshed via AuthService.RefreshToken; also personal access tokens with prefix "memos_pat_" for API clients (server/auth/token.go:37-52)
backend package — server/auth (Authenticator in server/auth/authenticator.go, JWT/PAT logic in server/auth/token.go), driven by the Authorizer used in both the gateway middleware and the Connect auth interceptor (server/router/api/v1/authz.go, wired in server/router/api/v1/v1.go:67-90,133-137)
```

The first three converge in `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:181,119`.
